Ni50Mn24.7Ga20Gd4.3 alloy exhibits a reversible martensitic transition at room temperature and the hardness of the martensitic phase varies between 3.5 and 3.8 GPa depending on the annealed state.
the Gd-rich and the Gd-pool phases of the Ni50Mn 25Ga20GdB5 magnetic shape memory material exhibit different hardness, which is related to their different microstructure.

(i) the annealing process causes a change in the microstructure of the alloy, (ii) the annealed alloy exhibits martensitic transformation at close to the room temperatures and (iii) the annealed sample is harder than the as-prepared one.

the influence of heat treatment on the microstructure, magnetism as well as nanomechanical behaviour of Ni50Mm25Ga20GdGd5 alloy.
a new magnetic shape memory alloy which is characterized by the presence of two distinct phases, which are both magnetic, and which exhibit different hardness values.
the influence of the Gd addition on the microstructural, magnetic and nanomechanics properties of the investigated NiMnGa magnetic shape memory alloy.

the annealed sample is more prone to the magnetic transformation and the Gd-rich martensite is harder than Gd-poor one.
the Gd-rich martensite is harder than the Gd-poon martensite and that annealing at 1400 K leads to the formation of the Gd-enriched phase with the hardness of approximately 2 GPa.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Gd-rich martensite phase is harder and stiffer than the Gd-pool phase.
Gd-rich phase has lower hardness and higher magnetic properties than Gd-poor one.
annealing treatment of Ni50Mm25Ga20G5 magnetic shape memory material results in a substantial change of its mechanical properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Gd-rich and the Gd-pour phases are not only microscopically different but they are also magnetically and mechanically distinguishable.
the Gd-rich and the Gd-pove phases exhibit different mechanical properties, which may be used in the future to develop novel NiMnGa-based actuators.

the annealed Ni50Mn 25Ga20GdGd5 magnetic shape-memory alloy exhibits the best combination of the properties, which is the prerequisite for the application of the alloy in the field of actuators and magnetic refrigerators.
